# Cloud ↔ Desktop sync, refresh and update controls

Issue #1115, workstream **P0 — Controls inventory + owner UX contract**. Every control below that touches the Cloud ↔ Windows boundary is classified by what it really does. `src/lib/sync-controls-inventory.ts` is the source; `src/lib/sync-controls-inventory.test.ts` fails when a listed file, route or label disappears, when a UI or Electron file that calls a sync, activation, pairing or update endpoint is not listed, or when this page is stale.

## Scope and limits

- Covered: every `src/app` / `src/components` file and Electron file that calls a Cloud ↔ site, activation, pairing, update, browser-queue or integration-sync endpoint, plus the scheduled jobs in `server.ts` that move data.
- Not enumerated one by one: module-level «reload this list» buttons (`load()` / «تازه‌سازی» on a screen that only re-reads its own API). They are `ui_reload`, call no endpoint above, and are not part of the replication contract. One WooCommerce example is listed.
- A static audit, not a runtime interaction matrix. Packaged-app click-through of each control belongs to the epic's E2E workstream.
- Nothing here is changed by this inventory. Where a control does less than its label suggests it is recorded as a finding.

## Categories

- `cloud_site_data_sync` (11) — Cloud ↔ site data sync (identity, operational events, master data)
- `activation_refresh` (6) — Activation / licence refresh (Full Offline)
- `software_update` (6) — Software update (signed installer, never data)
- `integration_sync` (8) — Third-party integration sync (WooCommerce, CMS, Holoo)
- `ui_reload` (3) — UI reload (re-reads data already on this side)
- `pairing_enrollment` (10) — Pairing / enrolment (binds or unbinds an install)
- `client_offline_queue` (4) — Client offline queue (browser → this site's own server)

## Findings

| Id | Severity | Finding | Owning workstream |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | misleading | Settings → Cloud & Sync «به‌روزرسانی» only dispatches the browser `online` event. That re-probes /api/connection/status and flushes the browser's own offline queue; it does not start a server-sync push or pull. Its label reads like a Cloud ↔ site refresh. | P1 — Force Send / Receive / Both |
| F2 | misleading | Server-sync «retry deferred / retry dead letter / discard» shows «عملیات آشتی‌سازی انجام شد» whenever the request returns 2xx. The response carries the reconciliation counts, but the panel never reads them, so a run that re-applied nothing reports the same success as one that cleared the backlog. | P0 — Controls inventory + owner UX contract |
| F3 | gap | No user-requested Cloud → site, site → Cloud or both-ways control exists. `runServerSyncTick` is reached only by the 30 s timer, the Postgres NOTIFY wake and the central long-poll in server.ts; no route, button or Electron channel starts it. The identity «sync now» buttons run the identity/credential plane only. | P1 — Force Send / Receive / Both |
| F4 | gap | No control reports `queued → running → verified` for entity data. Identity repair is the one verified control (it returns 503 unless identities and PIN credentials converge); everything else reports a timestamp, a count of its own queue or nothing. | P0 — Durable measured job/progress |
| F5 | gap | Superadmin has no scoped sync/status command for a Hybrid site. The only remote device commands are software-update `recheck` / `download_now` and consented Full Offline support sessions. Neither moves data, and both correctly stay queued until the device next calls in. | P1 — Fleet, update and support integration |
| F6 | note | The IAM card's «همگام‌سازی اکنون» and «تلاش دوباره» post `sync` and `retry`, which /api/team/iam-status treats identically (only `repair` differs). Two labels, one behaviour. | P0 — Controls inventory + owner UX contract |
| F7 | gap | Local → Hybrid conversion is operator-assisted only: scripts/convert-local-to-hybrid.ts, reached from the support page link («درخواست تبدیل امن»). There is no in-product preview, backup or explicit opt-in flow. | P1 — Simplify Full Offline URL/token wizard (future opt-in conversion) |
| F8 | note | No Electron IPC channel moves business data. The `desktop:update-*` channels are the signed software updater only, and must stay separate from any future data-sync command. | P1 — Force Send / Receive / Both |
